description: Upgrade of Elizabeth Drive from east of Mamre Road to Luddenham Road Badgerys Creek: Director-General's Report, Section 115C of the Environmental Planning and Assessment Act, April 1996 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The proposal is to upgrade a 9.4 km section of Elizabeth Drive from about 400 metres east of Mamre Road to Luddenham Road, located some 10 km north west of the Liverpool CBD (see Figure 1). Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
